methodology.mir_canonicalization: Strips full-line `//` comments, trailing `// [return place ]in scope ...`, `// scope ... at ...`, `// mir::...`, `// + ...` comments, and embedded `{closure@file:l1:c1: l2:c2}` / `<impl at file:l1:c1: l2:c2>` span coordinates while preserving 100% of basic blocks, local types, statements, rvalues, constants, and terminators. Also computes transitive `Const::Unevaluated` dependency cone on PostCleanup MIR.
llvm_ir_flags: tested at both -C codegen-units=1 and -C codegen-units=16
methodology.incremental_timing_protocol: Median of 3 clean cold `-O3 -C codegen-units=16` builds vs. median of 3 incremental `E0 -> Ei` rebuilds (`-C incremental=...`), resetting the incremental cache via a full independent directory copy (`shutil.copytree`) of `E0` before every single trial, pinning `E0`'s `.o` inodes in a side directory (`os.link`, verified immutable by SHA-256) so `rustc` session GC / `tmpfs` inode reuse never distort `.o` hardlink-reuse counts, and comparing both `.o` and `.pre-lto.bc` SHA-256 digests against `E0`.
